resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says Wayne County. The Forest Lookouts page says Lackawanna County and quotes a 1936 report placing the land in Carbondale Township, which is in Lackawanna County. The sources do not settle it, so the story reports both and the brief's Wayne County is left unchanged.

notes_for_editor: The 85-foot height is from a 1936 report made while the tower was under construction, not a measurement, so no height_m is recorded. The 1936 article is read only through the Forest Lookouts quote; the Scranton Republican itself was not read. County conflict is unresolved: FFLOS and the brief say Wayne, Forest Lookouts and the 1936 report point to Lackawanna. A mapcarta search snippet (not read) places it in Canaan Township, Wayne County, so Wayne may be right and the Carbondale Township wording refers to the land owner's holding. Check county records if this matters. The OpenStreetMap FIXME says the point is misplaced, so the brief's coordinates (41.550361, -75.456572) should not be trusted without checking. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403. No photos found, no access information, no staffing or fire records.
